messages:
Asha Patel: quick heads-up — int4 bring-up for q4b on staging showed a ~3% drop vs float baseline on PromptSet-Summarize (longform). doing a quick root-cause pass but want Labeling Ops to expand the golden coverage and run targeted relabels
Riley Chen: ouch. where is the delta concentrated? hallucination, truncation, or style?
Asha Patel: mostly missing detail and some inference errors on bullet-list extraction. short examples show the model drops factual recall. not massive but consistent across 1200 samples
Marta Gomez: we should avoid wholesale relabels. propose small focused waves: 500 high-entropy prompts + 300 edge-case paraphs. can we get the sample export?
Jin Park: I can export. will pull top-entropy by model-conf and token-length > 512. will also include prior golden matches for de-dupe.
Asha Patel: thanks. target is to get fresh golden for both canonical answers and allowed variance. also add a labeler instruction tweak mentioning "prefer preserving numeric detail"
labeler-bot: export job queued: job_id=job_2026_173659. results will be in s3://redwood-lab/exports/job_2026_173659.csv in ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Riley Chen: on de-dupe — prefer fuzzy-hash + token overlap. Marta, can ops run de-dupe with these params?
Marta Gomez: yes. using fuzzyhash_v2 with threshold=0.85 + token_jaccard>=0.6. will keep up to 3 paraphrases per canonical.
Kai: question: do we want to lock the current eval harness so we compare apples-to-apples (no prompt tweaks) or allow prompt normalization?
Asha Patel: lock harness. we need raw model behavior first. normalization comes after we confirm degradation persists post-golden update.
Jin Park: putting the export snippet here for reproducibility:
```
python tools/export_high_entropy.py --model q4b-int4-staging --metric entropy --top 500 \
  --min_tokens 512 --include_golden_matches true --out job_2026_173659.csv
```
Marta Gomez: will run de-dupe then split into labeling batches (50/sample) and mark priority=true for the highest conf-entropy quartile. labeler lead: @Riley PTAL on SLA
Riley Chen: can do. ETA for labeling wave 1 (800 samples): 48h once batches hit queue. I'll allocate 4 labelers full-time + 2 floaters.
Asha Patel: perfect. also: add a small verification micro-golden of 100 synth variants (paraphrases, truncations) to detect regressions quickly
labeler-bot: micro-golden job created: mg_173659_01. will inject into labeler queue after batch completion.
Jin Park: once labeled, we should run the new golden against the eval harness and diff token-level metrics. I'll create a dashboard tile: q4b_int4_vs_float_promptset_summarize
Kai: please include BLEU/ROUGE-L and our recall@fact metric. also token-latency changes for cost tradeoff notes
Marta Gomez: operational note: ensure labelers have updated guideline doc (v2.1) — I'll link it in the queue. small changes: keep numeric units exact, prefer explicit source mention if generated
Asha Patel: thanks team. next steps: Jin exports -> Marta de-dupes & queues -> Riley kicks labeling SLA -> labelers run + micro-golden -> Jin runs eval diff. flag me if we need canary rollback of q4b-int4 in Dedicated after results
Riley Chen: noted. ping when batches are live, I'll watch throughput and QA yields
Jin Park: export complete, uploaded: s3://redwood-lab/exports/job_2026_173659.csv, checksum md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
Marta Gomez: de-dupe finished. final sample count: 832 (500 high-entropy + 332 edge paraphs). pushing 17 batches to labeler-queue now
labeler-bot: 17 batches enqueued: queue_id=q_173659_a. estimated completion 48h based on current throughput
Asha Patel: awesome. after labels land let's meet 1:1 to review top 40 failures and decide whether this is quant artifact or data gap. thanks! :raised_hands:
